items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: he had this, this fellow called Snow on the guitar, and Jim Dixon, and myself, and Cornelius

ctx.x: Went with the shrines. I went to Indianapolis with him. I took my tenor banjo that, uh, when I, when I went up there, there people were surprised. They had never seen him, had never seen a tenor banjo up there before. Yeah? Oh. And, uh, I, uh, he had, he had this, this fellow called Snow on the guitar, and Jim Dixon, and myself, and Cornelius, that same fellow I told you, with, uh, had a cigarette you put behind his head. And, and the shrines, uh, the shrines hired him. He got, he got us. I was on my vacation. I…
And they paid, uh, your way and all your expenses? Oh, yeah, sure. Yeah.
